verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is a SaaS card-issuing platform with a Customer Area UI, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an in-product AI assistant for delegating tasks. The docs cover card APIs, transaction rules, webhooks and SDKs, and an llms.txt file (machine-readable docs for external tools) is not a built-in assistant.
